title: Luke Chapter 11 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Luke chapter 11 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Luke Chapter 11 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Luke Chapter 11.

questions.question: In Luke 11, which of the following appears FIRST in the chapter?
options: Jesus tells a parable about a friend at midnight
Jesus is accused of casting out devils through Beelzebub
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus teaches the Lord's Prayer
questions.explanation: Jesus teaching the Lord's Prayer is the first event, starting in Luke 11:1.

questions.question: Who asked Jesus to teach them to pray?
questions.correctAnswer: One of his disciples
questions.explanation: One of Jesus' disciples asked him to teach them to pray, as stated in Luke 11:1.

questions.question: According to Luke 11, what is the first phrase in the prayer Jesus taught?
options: Our Father which art in heaven
Give us day by day our daily bread
questions.correctAnswer: Our Father which art in heaven
questions.explanation: Jesus said, 'When ye pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven,' in Luke 11:2.

questions.question: In the prayer Jesus taught, what follows 'Hallowed be thy name'?
options: Give us day by day our daily bread
questions.correctAnswer: Thy kingdom come
questions.explanation: The prayer sequence includes 'Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come.' as in Luke 11:2.

questions.question: What does the prayer ask for day by day?
questions.correctAnswer: Daily bread
questions.explanation: The prayer says, 'Give us day by day our daily bread' in Luke 11:3.

questions.question: What reason is given for forgiving others in the prayer Jesus taught?
options: Because we also forgive every one that is indebted to us
questions.correctAnswer: Because we also forgive every one that is indebted to us
questions.explanation: The prayer includes 'And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us.' in Luke 11:4.

questions.question: In the parable Jesus told, what time of day does the man go to his friend to ask for loaves?
questions.correctAnswer: Midnight
questions.explanation: Jesus says, 'shall go unto him at midnight' in Luke 11:5.

questions.question: How many loaves does the man ask to borrow in Jesus' parable?
questions.correctAnswer: Three loaves
questions.explanation: The man asks for 'three loaves' as found in Luke 11:5.

questions.question: Why does the man in the parable say he needs the loaves?
options: A friend of mine in his journey is come to me
I have no bread for myself
questions.correctAnswer: A friend of mine in his journey is come to me
questions.explanation: The man says, 'For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me' in Luke 11:6.

questions.question: What excuse does the friend give for not wanting to get up and give bread?
options: The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed
questions.correctAnswer: The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed
questions.explanation: The friend says, 'the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed' in Luke 11:7.

questions.question: What does Jesus say will happen if you ask, seek, and knock?
options: It shall be given you, ye shall find, and it shall be opened unto you
questions.correctAnswer: It shall be given you, ye shall find, and it shall be opened unto you
questions.explanation: Jesus says, 'Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.' in Luke 11:9.

questions.question: True or False: Jesus said if a son asks his father for bread, the father will give him a stone.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Jesus said if a son asks for bread, will he give a stone? implying he will not, as stated in Luke 11:11.

questions.question: True or False: Jesus said the heavenly Father will give the Holy Spirit to those who ask Him.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Luke 11:13 states the heavenly Father will give the Holy Spirit to those that ask Him.

questions.question: True or False: Jesus was accused of casting out devils by the power of Beelzebub.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Some said Jesus cast out devils through Beelzebub, as in Luke 11:15.

questions.question: True or False: The chapter states Jesus was born in Bethlehem.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Luke 11 does not mention Jesus' birthplace; this fact is not stated in these verses.

medium.title: Luke Chapter 11 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Luke Chapter 11 to real-life situations.

questions.question: According to Luke 11:19, if Jesus casts out devils by Beelzebub, by whom do the sons of the people cast them out?
options: By whom your sons cast them out
questions.correctAnswer: By whom your sons cast them out
questions.explanation: Luke 11:19 says, 'And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.' This indicates that the sons cast them out by some power acknowledged by Jesus, challenging the accusation.

questions.question: What does Luke 11:20 promise will happen if someone casts out devils with the finger of God, as mentioned in Luke 11:19?
options: The kingdom of God will come upon them
They will be judged by their sons
questions.correctAnswer: The kingdom of God will come upon them
questions.explanation: Luke 11:20 states, 'But if I with the finger of God cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you,' promising the kingdom's arrival upon those involved.

questions.question: In Luke 11:21, what is said about the goods of a strong man armed when he keeps his palace?
questions.correctAnswer: His goods are in peace
questions.explanation: Luke 11:21 says, 'When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, his goods are in peace,' meaning his possessions are secure.

questions.question: How do Luke 11:24 and Luke 11:25 together describe the behavior of an unclean spirit after leaving a man?
options: It wanders seeking rest and finds the house swept and garnished
It immediately leaves and never returns
It finds a new host immediately
It is cast into the abyss
questions.correctAnswer: It wanders seeking rest and finds the house swept and garnished
questions.explanation: Luke 11:24-25 describe the unclean spirit wandering through dry places seeking rest, and when it returns, it finds the house swept and garnished.

questions.question: What is the consequence mentioned in Luke 11:26 for a man after an unclean spirit returns with seven other spirits?
options: His last state is worse than the first
questions.correctAnswer: His last state is worse than the first
questions.explanation: Luke 11:26 states that when the unclean spirit returns with seven other spirits more wicked, 'the last state of that man is worse than the first.'

questions.question: According to Luke 11:28, who does Jesus say are blessed?
options: Those who hear the word of God and keep it
questions.correctAnswer: Those who hear the word of God and keep it
questions.explanation: Luke 11:28 records Jesus saying, 'Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it,' emphasizing obedience to God's word.

questions.question: What sign does Jesus say will be given to this evil generation, according to Luke 11:29?
options: The sign of Jonas the prophet
The sign of the coming kingdom
questions.correctAnswer: The sign of Jonas the prophet
questions.explanation: Luke 11:29 states, 'there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet,' indicating the only sign given to that generation.

questions.question: How does Luke 11:31 describe the queen of the south’s role in judgment compared to the men of Jesus’ generation?
options: She shall rise up in judgment and condemn them
She will join them in condemnation
questions.correctAnswer: She shall rise up in judgment and condemn them
questions.explanation: Luke 11:31 says, 'The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them,' showing her condemning role due to their unbelief.

questions.question: According to Luke 11:33, where does no man put a lighted candle?
options: In a secret place or under a bushel
questions.correctAnswer: In a secret place or under a bushel
questions.explanation: Luke 11:33 states, 'No man, when he hath lighted a candle, putteth it in a secret place, neither under a bushel,' indicating light is meant to be seen.

questions.question: What does Luke 11:34 say is the light of the body?
questions.correctAnswer: The eye
questions.explanation: Luke 11:34 states, 'The light of the body is the eye,' emphasizing the eye's role in spiritual perception.

questions.question: According to Luke 11:35, what should believers take heed of regarding the light in them?
options: That the light in thee be not darkness
questions.correctAnswer: That the light in thee be not darkness
questions.explanation: Luke 11:35 warns, 'Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness,' urging vigilance about inner spiritual truth.

questions.question: How does Luke 11:36 describe a body full of light?
options: It is like the bright shining of a candle
questions.correctAnswer: It is like the bright shining of a candle
questions.explanation: Luke 11:36 says, 'If thy whole body therefore be full of light... the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light.'

questions.question: According to Luke 11:23, what is said about someone who is not with Jesus?
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Luke 11:23 states, 'He that is not with me is against me: and he that gathereth not with me scattereth,' affirming the necessity of allegiance to Jesus.

questions.question: Is it true that Luke 11:13 teaches that God will give the Holy Spirit only to those who are perfect?
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Luke 11:13 says God will give the Holy Spirit to those who ask Him, not only to the perfect, emphasizing God's generosity to all who ask.

questions.question: Does Luke 11:9 teach that if you knock, the door will never be opened to you?
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Luke 11:9 clearly states, 'knock, and it shall be opened unto you,' promising that the door will be opened to those who knock.

hard.title: Luke Chapter 11 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Luke Chapter 11.

questions.question: What did the Pharisee marvel at when Jesus sat down to dinner?
options: That Jesus did not wash before dinner
questions.correctAnswer: That Jesus did not wash before dinner
questions.explanation: The Pharisee marveled that Jesus had not first washed before dinner, as noted in Luke 11:38.

questions.question: What did Jesus say about the Pharisees' practices?
options: They clean the outside but neglect the inside
questions.correctAnswer: They clean the outside but neglect the inside
questions.explanation: Jesus criticized the Pharisees for making clean the outside of the cup while their inward parts were full of wickedness, as stated in Luke 11:39.

questions.question: What does Jesus refer to the Pharisees as in Luke 11:40?
questions.correctAnswer: Fools
questions.explanation: Jesus calls the Pharisees 'fools' for their hypocrisy regarding outward cleanliness versus inward wickedness in Luke 11:40.

questions.question: What is said to be clean unto the Pharisees according to Jesus?
questions.correctAnswer: All things
questions.explanation: Jesus states that if the Pharisees give alms of what they have, then all things are clean unto them, as seen in Luke 11:41.

questions.question: What did Jesus say woe to the Pharisees for in Luke 11:42?
questions.correctAnswer: Tithing herbs
questions.explanation: Jesus pronounced woe upon the Pharisees for tithing mint and rue while neglecting justice and the love of God, as mentioned in Luke 11:42.

questions.question: According to Jesus in Luke 11:43, what do the Pharisees love?
questions.correctAnswer: The uppermost seats
questions.explanation: Jesus criticizes the Pharisees for loving the uppermost seats in synagogues and greetings in markets, as stated in Luke 11:43.

questions.question: What does the Greek word 'ἀλς' (als) in Luke 11:41 mean?
questions.correctAnswer: Salt
questions.explanation: The Greek word 'ἀλς' (als) means 'salt', which is often used in the context of preservation and flavor, implying purity and value.

questions.question: Which literary technique is used in Jesus' criticism of the Pharisees in Luke 11:39-44?
questions.correctAnswer: Parallelism
questions.explanation: The use of parallelism can be seen in Jesus’ contrasting statements about the outside and inside of the cup, highlighting their hypocrisy.

questions.question: Which other Bible passage connects to the theme of hypocrisy in Luke 11:44?
questions.correctAnswer: Matthew 23:27
questions.explanation: Matthew 23:27 parallels the theme of hypocrisy, where Jesus calls the Pharisees 'whitewashed tombs' that appear beautiful outwardly but are full of dead bones.

questions.question: Which other Bible passage fulfills the theme of justice mentioned in Luke 11:42?
questions.correctAnswer: Micah 6:8
questions.explanation: Micah 6:8 calls for justice, mercy, and humility, which connects to Jesus’ admonition to the Pharisees for neglecting justice in Luke 11:42.

questions.question: What comes immediately before Jesus' statement about the Pharisees in Luke 11:39?
options: He was dining with a Pharisee
He taught the disciples to pray
questions.correctAnswer: He was dining with a Pharisee
questions.explanation: Luke 11:37 describes that Jesus was dining with a Pharisee when he made the statement about the Pharisees' outward cleanliness.

questions.question: What does Jesus accuse the lawyers of in Luke 11:46?
questions.correctAnswer: Laying grievous burdens on men
questions.explanation: Jesus accuses the lawyers of laying burdens grievous to be borne on men, while they do not help carry those burdens, as seen in Luke 11:46.

questions.question: Woe is pronounced upon the lawyers for taking away what in Luke 11:52?
questions.correctAnswer: The keys of knowledge
questions.explanation: Jesus says woe to the lawyers for taking away the key of knowledge, preventing others from entering, as noted in Luke 11:52.

questions.question: True or False: Jesus teaches that outward appearances are more important than inner morality.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Jesus emphasizes the importance of inner morality over outward appearances, as seen throughout Luke 11:39-44.

questions.question: True or False: Jesus acknowledges the prophets killed by the ancestors of the Pharisees.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Jesus acknowledges that the Pharisees' ancestors killed the prophets, which he condemns in Luke 11:47-48.

theological.title: Luke Chapter 11 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Luke Chapter 11 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What doctrine does Luke 11:4 teach about the nature of human sin and divine forgiveness?
options: Forgiveness is conditional upon forgiving others
Forgiveness is automatic regardless of human response
Sin does not separate humans from God
Forgiveness is earned by good works
questions.correctAnswer: Forgiveness is conditional upon forgiving others
questions.explanation: Luke 11:4 states 'And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us,' indicating that divine forgiveness is connected to our willingness to forgive others.

questions.question: What doctrine does Luke 11:13 teach about God's provision in the life of believers?
options: God gives the Holy Spirit to those who ask
God withholds the Spirit until perfect obedience
The Holy Spirit is given only to the apostles
God's gifts are arbitrary and unpredictable
questions.correctAnswer: God gives the Holy Spirit to those who ask
questions.explanation: Luke 11:13 says, 'how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?' affirming that God generously grants the Holy Spirit upon request.

questions.question: What doctrine about spiritual warfare and authority is taught in Luke 11:22?
options: Christ, stronger than Satan, overcomes and disarms him
Believers have no authority over evil spirits
The strong man is never overcome
questions.correctAnswer: Christ, stronger than Satan, overcomes and disarms him
questions.explanation: Luke 11:22 states that 'when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted,' symbolizing Christ's victory over Satan.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Luke 11:17 specifically demonstrate by Jesus knowing the thoughts of his opponents?
questions.correctAnswer: Omniscience
questions.explanation: Luke 11:17 says 'But he, knowing their thoughts,' demonstrating Jesus' divine attribute of omniscience, knowing the inner thoughts of men.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is highlighted in Luke 11:9, where God is portrayed as responsive to persistent prayer?
questions.correctAnswer: Longsuffering
questions.explanation: Luke 11:9 encourages persistence in asking, seeking, and knocking, showing God's longsuffering patience and willingness to respond to prayer.

questions.question: How does Luke 11:29–30 connect with Old Testament prophetic typology?
options: Jesus is the ultimate sign like Jonah was to Nineveh
Jesus fulfills the law but not the prophets
Jesus is unrelated to Jonah's mission
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus is the ultimate sign like Jonah was to Nineveh
questions.explanation: Luke 11:29-30 parallels Jesus to Jonah, indicating that Jesus is the greater sign to the generation, fulfilling prophetic typology about repentance and salvation.

questions.question: What redemptive-historical connection does Luke 11:50-51 make regarding the persecution of prophets?
options: It links Jesus’ generation to the entire history of prophetic rejection
It absolves the Jewish leaders of responsibility
It implies prophets were always accepted
It focuses only on the Old Testament era
questions.correctAnswer: It links Jesus’ generation to the entire history of prophetic rejection
questions.explanation: Luke 11:50-51 speaks of the blood of prophets shed from Abel to Zacharias, holding Jesus’ contemporaries accountable as part of this ongoing pattern.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Luke 11:9 and Luke 11:13 teach about prayer and the Spirit?
options: Persistent prayer results in receiving the Holy Spirit
Prayer is unnecessary for receiving the Spirit
The Spirit is given randomly without prayer
Prayer weakens faith in the Spirit
questions.correctAnswer: Persistent prayer results in receiving the Holy Spirit
questions.explanation: Luke 11:9 commands to ask, seek, and knock, while 11:13 promises that God will give the Holy Spirit to those who ask, linking prayer and Spirit reception.

questions.question: What doctrine about spiritual blindness and knowledge is taught by synthesizing Luke 11:34 and Luke 11:52?
options: True knowledge requires a single, undivided spiritual eye and access to the key of knowledge
All have equal access to knowledge without hindrance
questions.correctAnswer: True knowledge requires a single, undivided spiritual eye and access to the key of knowledge
questions.explanation: Luke 11:34 emphasizes the eye as the light of the body (spiritual perception), and 11:52 condemns lawyers for taking away the key of knowledge, connecting spiritual sight and access to truth.

questions.question: What combined doctrine about hypocrisy and judgment emerges from Luke 11:39 and Luke 11:44?
options: External cleanliness without internal righteousness is hypocrisy that leads to judgment
Only external actions matter before God
Hypocrisy is acceptable if religious rituals are performed
Judgment is irrelevant to human conduct
questions.correctAnswer: External cleanliness without internal righteousness is hypocrisy that leads to judgment
questions.explanation: Luke 11:39 rebukes Pharisees for cleaning outside but not inside, and 11:44 calls them hypocrites like unmarked graves, illustrating internal corruption hidden by external appearances.

questions.question: Skeptics claim Jesus casts out demons by demonic power. What does Luke 11:15-20 actually teach about the source of Jesus’ authority?
options: Jesus casts out demons by the finger of God, proving the kingdom of God is present
Jesus uses demonic power to cast out demons
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus casts out demons by the finger of God, proving the kingdom of God is present
questions.explanation: Luke 11:20 states 'if I with the finger of God cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you,' affirming divine authority, not demonic.

questions.question: What doctrine about the human heart and true purity is taught in Luke 11:40?
options: God made both the external and internal parts, so inward purity is required
The body is evil and cannot be made clean
Inward parts are irrelevant to holiness
questions.correctAnswer: God made both the external and internal parts, so inward purity is required
questions.explanation: Luke 11:40 asks rhetorically if the maker of the outside did not also make the inside, emphasizing the need for inner holiness.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is illustrated in Luke 11:36 regarding the fullness of light in the believer?
questions.correctAnswer: Holiness
questions.explanation: Luke 11:36 describes the whole body being full of light, symbolizing holiness as the divine attribute filling the believer.

questions.question: How does Luke 11:24-26 contribute to the theological understanding of the consequences of spiritual emptiness?
options: A person cleansed but not filled can become worse than before
Once cleansed, a person is permanently safe
Spiritual emptiness has no real danger
Evil spirits cannot return once cast out
questions.correctAnswer: A person cleansed but not filled can become worse than before
questions.explanation: Luke 11:26 explains that an unclean spirit returning finds the house swept and garnished and brings seven more spirits worse than itself, worsening the person's state.

questions.question: What narrative role does the woman’s blessing in Luke 11:27-28 play in emphasizing true blessedness?
options: It contrasts physical descent from Jesus with obedience to God's word
It elevates physical lineage above spiritual obedience
It dismisses the importance of hearing God’s word
It affirms only biological relationships matter
questions.correctAnswer: It contrasts physical descent from Jesus with obedience to God's word
questions.explanation: Luke 11:28 shows Jesus correcting the woman by saying 'blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it,' emphasizing spiritual obedience over physical descent.
